name: 咖啡椅
description: One freestanding miniature mint and ivory cafe chair: rounded rectangular mint upholstered-looking molded plastic back and seat, slim ivory metal tube frame and four legs. No table, no umbrella, no ground.
baseline_generation_prompt: Create a professional 3D ASSET DESIGN REFERENCE SHEET for subsequent single-object image-to-3D generation. Use input image as style and object identity reference, extracting ONLY the specified object, reinterpreting hidden surfaces conservatively to make a complete buildable freestanding asset. One image in landscape 3:2 format with EXACTLY FOUR equally sized rectangular cells in a precise 2x2 grid. White background throughout, generous clear margin around each object so no silhouettes touch cell boundaries. TOP LEFT: straight FRONT orthographic view. TOP RIGHT: straight RIGHT SIDE orthographic view. BOTTOM LEFT: straight BACK orthographic view. BOTTOM RIGHT: elevated front three-quarter view. All four cells show the SAME SINGLE OBJECT at identical relative scale, same geometry and colors, no alternate designs. Use neutral shadowless studio illumination, readable material colors, no cast shadows, no bloom, no atmospheric effects, no room/table environment, no text, no labels, no watermarks, no dimensions. Tactile high quality miniature model product photography, satin ivory painted resin, mint green trim, pale peach accents, restrained metal and acrylic, clean simplified structural details. Every asset must be isolated with complete silhouette and visible bottom feet, physically plausible closed construction. No race track, no terrain, no diorama base, no unrelated neighboring props. Primary object: One freestanding miniature mint and ivory cafe chair: rounded rectangular mint upholstered-looking molded plastic back and seat, slim ivory metal tube frame and four legs. No table, no umbrella, no ground.
